ADVICE_FOR_CODE.ERR_BOOST_INTERNAL: The plugin failed internally. Nothing on disk changed. Check the host log.
ADVICE_FOR_CODE.ERR_BOOST_INVALID_ARGS: The request is missing a required field.
ADVICE_FOR_CODE.ERR_BOOST_INVALID_BODY: A field value is invalid, so the whole write was rejected — nothing on disk changed.
ADVICE_FOR_CODE.ERR_CLIENT_NETWORK: The page could not reach the plugin's route. It may not be mounted — look for webServer in the host log.
ADVICE_FOR_CODE.ERR_CLIENT_SHAPE: The plugin returned a shape this page does not recognise; most likely a version mismatch.
ADVICE_FOR_CODE.ERR_HTTP_BODY: The request body is not valid JSON, or exceeds 64 KiB.
ADVICE_FOR_CODE.ERR_HTTP_FORBIDDEN: The same-origin fence rejected the request: Host is not trusted, or Origin does not match Host.
ADVICE_FOR_CODE.ERR_HTTP_INTERNAL: The server threw while reading state — usually a host service failing internally. Check the host log.
ADVICE_FOR_CODE.ERR_HTTP_METHOD: Wrong method: /state only reads, /scope only accepts POST. The page does not send this; another caller does.
ADVICE_FOR_CODE.ERR_HTTP_NOT_FOUND: The plugin has no such sub-path: page and server versions may disagree.
ADVICE_FOR_CODE.ERR_HTTP_WORKSPACES_UNAV: The workspace list could not be read, so saving is disabled. This is not 'no workspaces' — the host offered no registry, or reading it threw.
ADVICE_FOR_CODE.ERR_SCOPE_ABORTED: The request was cancelled. Nothing on disk changed.
ADVICE_FOR_CODE.ERR_SCOPE_FUTURE_VERSION: The document on disk was written by a newer plugin. This version will not touch it. Upgrade the plugin.
ADVICE_FOR_CODE.ERR_SCOPE_LOCKED: The write lock is not available: usually another writer holds it, but the lock file may also fail to be created (permissions or disk). Make sure no other `boost` is writing, then retry.
ADVICE_FOR_CODE.ERR_SCOPE_PARSE_FAILED: The document on disk is not valid JSON. This version will not touch it. Inspect scope.json in the boost directory by hand.
ADVICE_FOR_CODE.ERR_SCOPE_READ_FAILED: The scope document on disk could not be read, so the baseline is unknown. Check permissions on the boost directory.
ADVICE_FOR_CODE.ERR_SCOPE_REVISION_CONFL: The document on disk changed elsewhere, so this save was rejected. Use 'Re-read' to start from the new document — your unsaved changes are lost, so that call is yours.
ADVICE_FOR_CODE.ERR_SCOPE_UNKNOWN_VERSIO: The document version on disk is unrecognised. This version will not touch it. Inspect scope.json in the boost directory by hand.
ADVICE_FOR_CODE.ERR_SCOPE_WRITE_FAILED: Writing to disk failed. Nothing on disk changed. Check permissions and free space on the boost directory.
CONFIG_READONLY: This section is read-only. It shows what resolveConfig decided at load (clamps and fallbacks included); to change it, edit the profile's cordis.patch.yml and restart the host.
CONFIG_UNAVAILABLE: Could not read the effective config: `/state` did not return one this time.
DEGRADED_ADVICE.ERR_BOOST_PARTIAL_MOUNT: A hook did not mount: the plugin is only partly wired. Check the host log for the missing item.
DEGRADED_ADVICE.ERR_BOOST_SECTION_REGIST: Registering the prompt section failed: the protocol section is not injected.
DEGRADED_ADVICE.ERR_HOST_COMPLETE_SECTIO: The host swallowed the prompt section: the protocol text may never reach the model.
DEGRADED_ADVICE.ERR_HOST_NO_ESTIMATOR: The host has no estimator: fixed overhead can only be unknown. Do not read it as zero.
DEGRADED_ADVICE.ERR_HOST_NO_SPILL: No spill backend: projection does not happen. Install dsh-spill or an equivalent spill service.
DEGRADED_ADVICE.ERR_HOST_NO_SPILL_NOTICE: The spill backend is present but the footer cannot be produced, so projection was skipped. Check whether the spill notice module was pruned.
DEGRADED_ADVICE.ERR_HOST_NO_TOKENMETER: No token meter: substitution is refused; projection still works but its numbers are marked unmeasured.
DEGRADED_ADVICE.ERR_HOST_NO_WORKSPACE_RE: The host offers no workspace registry, so no session resolves to a workspace and the plugin stays inert.
DEGRADED_ADVICE.ERR_HOST_PLATFORM_UNSUPP: Substitution is off on this platform; projection still works.
DEGRADED_ADVICE.ERR_HOST_SELECTOR_UNAVAI: The selector cannot reach a model: multiple candidates fall back to the main model.
DEGRADED_ADVICE.ERR_HOST_SPILL_FAILING: The spill backend is present but every write fails, so projection was skipped. Check the backend's log; do not reinstall.
DEGRADED_ADVICE.ERR_HOST_SPILL_UNUSABLE: The spill backend exists but is unusable (no saveText): projection was skipped.
DEGRADED_ADVICE.ERR_HOST_VERSION_MISMATC: The host version is outside engines.dsh: this package was not verified against it.
DEGRADED_ADVICE.ERR_HOST_WORKSPACE_REGIS: The workspace registry exists but list() throws: the workspace list cannot be read.
DEGRADED_ADVICE.ERR_RECEIPTS_TRUNCATED: Too many receipt shards: only the first 256 were read, so the totals are low. Shards are never pruned automatically — move the old boost/receipts directory aside and start over.
DEGRADED_ADVICE.ERR_RECEIPTS_UNREADABLE: A receipt shard could not be read: its share is missing from the totals, which read low.
DEGRADED_FALLBACK: Code not in the table: see the stable-code list in docs/RELEASE.md.
EMPTY_GLOBAL: Every workspace is in scope; the list below is kept only as a record.
EMPTY_SELECTED: Only selected workspaces are in scope, and none is selected — the plugin does nothing at all.
HINT_NO_WORKSPACES_TO_PICK: The host's registry has no workspaces, so there is nothing to pick.
HINT_OVERHEAD: The total for the protocol section plus tool schemas. The protocol section is injected only when a workspace is visible, so one request currently pays just part of it (only the tool schemas when nothing is visible). No saving offsets it.
HINT_PROJECTION_GROSS_REPLAY: Each receipt's saving multiplied by its own (1 + horizon), summed. This is the figure the net is derived from.
HINT_PROJECTION_NET: Net = replay gross − retrieval content cost − retrieval call cost. Replay uses each receipt's own horizon, not the current one; so the two gross figures above are not the same number, and only the replay one lines up with the net.
HINT_PROJECTION_ON_ROLLBACK: To roll back, set projection back to `shadow` and save; or call the `boost` tool with `cmd: "scope-set"` and `body: {"projection": "shadow"}`. The change applies to subsequent requests with no host restart.
HINT_PROJECTION_ON_SPILL: Projection needs a spill backend: the original has to land somewhere, or the truncated text is the only copy. The host did not resolve one (`status.hasSpill` is false). Install one (`dsh-spill-local` or your own) and restart.
HINT_SAVED_LOWER: The lower bound is the skipped request's own total usage: it excludes how many more times it would have been replayed, so the true saving is at least this much.
HINT_SAVED_UPPER: The upper bound is the next request's input: it counts the replaced call's result as saved, so the true saving is at most this much.
HINT_SHADOW_MEANS: Shadow mode: the plugin still decides and records receipts, but never changes what reaches the model.
HINT_SUBSTITUTE_ON_ROLLBACK: To roll back, tick shadow mode again and save: substitution stops at once and the projection setting is untouched.
HINT_SUBSTITUTE_ON_THINKING: Watch for one 400 mentioning `content[].thinking` after the first real substitution. Synthesized turns carry no `replayState`, so the host-side conversion drops the thinking block; whether this route is an Anthropic-compatible thinking mode cannot be determined on this machine and only shows up on a real substitution.
INTRO: Projection trims tool receipts; deterministic substitution replaces derivable calls. Every number below comes from receipts, not from an estimate: the range gives a lower and an upper bound, and neither is exact.
LABEL_PROJECTION_ON_PRECONDITIONS: One thing to check before switching projection on
LABEL_SAVE_FAILED: The save did not take effect:
LABEL_STALE_IDS: Workspaces the next save would keep, but the registry does not have
LABEL_SUBSTITUTE_ON_PRECONDITIONS: One thing to check before switching shadow mode off
NO_DEGRADED: Nothing degraded: the degraded list read empty this time (which is not the same as the host providing every service — some absences only reach the log).
NO_RECEIPTS: No receipts yet: the plugin has not made a single decision on this host.
SAVED: Matches the document as this page last read or saved it. The page does not poll: if something else changes the scope (say, the model runs boost), reload to see it.
TITLE: Token efficiency
UNAVAILABLE_REGISTRY: The scope document could not be read, so this section is read-only for now.

meta.description: Cut DeepSeek Harness token usage by projecting tool receipts and substituting deterministic read-only calls.
meta.title: dsh-boost

STATUS_UNAVAILABLE: Status could not be read: the figures below are unread, not empty
ADVICE_FOR_CODE.ERR_RECEIPTS_UNREADABLE: Some receipt shards could not be read, so the totals are low. Shards are never pruned automatically, so this is usually permissions or disk: check the boost directory, or move the whole receipts directory aside and start over.
ADVICE_FOR_CODE.ERR_HOST_NO_SPILL: The host has no usable spill backend, so projection was skipped: the receipt reaches history untouched, nothing was dropped. Install a spill backend (`dsh-spill-local` or your own) and restart, and projection starts.
HINT_PROJECTION_ON_SPILL_OK: The host resolved a spill backend (`status.hasSpill` is true), so the original will land there. That proves the backend is present, not that it can write — `boost status` reports `ERR_HOST_SPILL_UNUSABLE` when it cannot.
HINT_PROJECTION_ON_SPILL_UNKNOWN: Projection needs a spill backend: the original has to land somewhere, or the truncated text is the only copy. `status.hasSpill` cannot be read right now, so there is no telling whether the host has one — fix the status read first, or install one (`dsh-spill-local` or your own).
LABEL_HORIZON_REESTIMATED: Receipts re-estimated at the current horizon
HINT_CACHE_HIT_RATIO: cacheRead over all input on the most recent real request. With no sample this shows "unknown", never 0.
HINT_PREFIX_DROPS: Within one session, how often cacheRead fell below the previous request's total input, and by how much. Compaction or a route change also causes this, so it is a diagnostic, not an alarm.
HINT_DISTILL_CALLS: Every receipt over the trigger costs one extra model call. It is an auxiliary request, so it never enters the usage ledger — the saving and the spend have to be read separately.
HINT_DISTILL_PINNED: A product is pinned by (receipt, question, version): changing the model or the question text affects only new receipts, never the pinned ones.
HINT_DISTILL_ROLLBACK: Turning it off affects only later receipts; bytes already in history do not roll back. To retry one receipt, delete its file under <dshHome>/boost/distilled/.
CONFIG_UNAVAILABLE_CODE: The effective config could not be read: `/state` answered with a failure this time.
DISTILL_NOT_IN_CONFIG: This host's config has no `distillation` section: the host process is most likely still running a build from before 0.3.0. Restart the host and this section appears.
HINT_DISTILL_OFF: Distillation is off, so none of these numbers exist: no calls, no products.
